svg.title: Numbered two-zone thermal circuit
svg.desc: Two room-air nodes connect to separate wall, roof and floor storage nodes through massless inner surfaces. Each surface exchanges heat by convection and linearized radiation. Outdoor window, door and ventilation paths and a setpoint-controller path connect directly to room air. A shared partition storage node and a resistance-only internal door couple the two rooms. Node and branch numbers match the notebook tables.

g.text: Branch and node numbers correspond to the notebook tables
C marks stored heat; surface nodes have C = 0. Arrows define positive flow.
Radiation uses the room-air temperature as a proxy for mean radiant temperature.
